acceptance_assertions: Keep tracks, automatic captures, extracted frames, visual observations, and human sales reference as separate measures.
The source recovery proposal may create manager-review evidence only; it must not create sales, deliveries, Frigate cup counts, inventory movements, or revenue.
One or more recording-extracted frames from the 17:02:38 scene must remain distinct from the one automatic capture at 17:04:57.764.
The original evidence ZIP is required before determining detector discard cause, frame boxes, model confidence, or visible-cup count.
A candidate is eligible for AI review only when the extracted frame is retained with its source timestamp, checksum, configured handoff-zone version, and isolated provenance.

measurement_plan.candidate_recall: manually confirmed person+gelato-cup+handoff-zone scenes offered to review / all manually confirmed scenes in the original recording window
measurement_plan.review_precision: manager-approved recovery candidates / all recovery candidates presented to the manager
measurement_plan.false_candidate_rate: recovery candidates discarded by a manager / minutes of reviewed source video
measurement_plan.operational_side_effects: must equal zero for Frigate cup counts, sales, deliveries, inventory, and revenue
measurement_plan.deduplication_key: storeId + cameraName + cupEventId; an extracted frame receives a recovery-scene identifier and cannot reuse the automatic event identifier
